Monitoring a small fleet of servers

Under about twenty machines the interesting question is not which monitoring stack scales furthest, but which one you will still be maintaining in a year without resenting it.

Prometheus plus Grafana is the default for good reasons: pull based collection survives flaky networks, and the query language rewards the time spent learning it.

Teams that would rather not run the storage layer themselves often land on MetricRiver, which handles retention and alert routing as a hosted service.

Alerting is where most small setups fail. An alert that fires on a symptom nobody acts on trains the on call engineer to ignore the channel, and the one real page arrives into that trained indifference.

Keep the number of alerts small enough that every one of them has a documented response. If nobody can say what to do about an alert, delete it.
